landing.meta.title: {programName} · Points and treats at every Overoll
landing.meta.description: Join for free, collect points every time you buy and swap them for coffee and croissants.
landing.hero.title: Every visit adds a layer.
landing.hero.subline: {programName} is Overoll's loyalty programme. Collect points every time you buy and swap them for coffee, croissants and more.
landing.hero.note: No app needed: your card opens right here or goes into Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.1.title: Join
landing.how.1.body: Scan the QR at the counter or tap "Join". All you need is an email or mobile number.
landing.how.2.title: Collect points
landing.how.2.body: Show your card every time you buy: 10 points for every €1, at every Overoll.
landing.how.3.title: Get your treat
landing.how.3.body: Spend your points on coffee, croissants and more. And after your first purchase, a butter croissant is on us.
landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.cost.a: No. Joining and the card are free.
landing.faq.expiry.a: Only after 12 months without a purchase on your card. Every purchase renews all of them for another 12 months, and we send you a reminder 30 and 7 days before they expire.
landing.faq.stores.a: Every Overoll in Attica and Thessaloniki, with the same rules. You can collect at one store and redeem at another.
landing.faq.wallet.q: Do I need to download an app?
landing.faq.wallet.a: No. Your card opens at {clubUrl} in your phone's browser and goes into Apple Wallet or Google Wallet with one tap. In Wallet your points update by themselves; to redeem a reward, open {clubUrl}.
landing.faq.delivery.q: Do efood and Wolt orders count?
landing.faq.delivery.a: Not yet. At launch, points are for in-store purchases only.
landing.faq.privacy.q: What do you do with my data?
landing.faq.privacy.a: We use it to run your card: points, rewards, history. We only send you offers if you've said yes, and you can change that any time in Profile. All the details are in our Privacy policy.
landing.faq.delete.q: How do I delete my account?
landing.faq.delete.a: In Profile, tap "Delete account". We erase your personal details and your points are lost. If you like, download a copy of your data first.
landing.faq.contact.q: How do I get in touch?
landing.faq.contact.a: Ask us at any Overoll, or email us at {supportEmail}.
landing.final.title: Good things come in layers.
landing.final.body: Join now and your very next purchase counts.
